name: DirectOrders Instagram DM / WhatsApp / ChatGPT ordering vs Owner web-app
summary: DirectOrders publishes Instagram DM, WhatsApp, ChatGPT, and Perplexity ordering channels alongside branded web/app (0% commission, $0 customer fees on Pro). Public comparison vs Owner.com notes Owner does not list IG DM/WhatsApp/ChatGPT on pricing — sharpens love→buy-now rival set: messaging-native first-party close vs Never86 in-app Shop. Watch only; fee catalog pause.
not_this: Not fee dogfood (no published per-order fee to teach). Competitor-authored comparison — treat channel claims as vendor-published, not third-party audit.
